create_ProgressBar: create a ProgressBar instance to display task completion progress in the terminal
update_ProgressBar: update the ProgressBar to advance the completed task count and refresh the display
track_progress: track the progress of sequential task execution with a progress bar
track_parallel_progress: track the progress of parallel task execution across multiple worker processes
track_iter_progress: track the progress of iterating over a sequence of tasks with a progress bar
